name: Iván Benito Sánchez

en.tagline: I build end-to-end data platforms: from pipeline to dashboard, with secure, reliable data.
about: Analytics Engineer and Data & BI Analyst with a background in Business Administration and Business Analytics, certified as a Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate.

I build complete data solutions on Microsoft Fabric: data pipelines and ETL/ELT with Data Factory and T-SQL, data warehouse and dimensional modeling (star schema), Power BI semantic models and dashboards, and data security and governance.

I care about reliable data that the business can actually use to make decisions. I am looking for an Analytics Engineer, BI Engineer, Data Analyst or BI Analyst position where I can add value on a real data platform.

headline: Analytics Engineer | Data & BI Analyst | Microsoft Fabric
tagline: Construyo plataformas de datos de extremo a extremo: del pipeline al dashboard, con el dato seguro y fiable.
about: Analytics Engineer y analista de datos y BI, con formación en ADE y Business Analytics, certificado como Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer Associate.

Construyo soluciones de datos completas sobre Microsoft Fabric: pipelines de datos y ETL/ELT con Data Factory y T-SQL, data warehouse y modelado dimensional (esquema en estrella), modelos semánticos y dashboards en Power BI, y seguridad y gobierno del dato.

Me interesa que el dato sea fiable y que el negocio lo use para decidir. Busco un puesto de Analytics Engineer, BI Engineer, Data Analyst o BI Analyst donde aportar valor sobre una plataforma de datos real.
